subject: code/validate_results_profiles.py evaluate()
note: each defect must be refused by the rule named for it; the envelope-only control exists because NOT satisfying a profile must stay a legal state, or the validator becomes a gate that excludes an honest line

D1_no_boundary_statement.why: a results file with no stated boundary must not pass the envelope
reported: global_status.statement must be a non-empty string

D2_solved_is_a_string_not_a_boolean.why: 'false' is truthy; the solved flag must be typed, not merely present

D3_a_verified_claim_without_its_text.why: an id with no claim renders as an empty claim-box row
reported: verified_claims[0] needs both id and claim

D4_an_empty_non_claim_string.why: a blank non-claim is worse than none: it renders as a silent boundary
reported: every explicit_non_claims entry must be a non-empty string

D5_verified_claims_present_but_empty.why: an empty array must not read as 'claims satisfied'
reported: verified_claims must be a non-empty array

D6_no_researcher.why: a results file with no attributable author fails the envelope

D7_claims_must_not_pass_over_a_broken_en.why: a renderer told 'claims ok' would trust an unidentifiable file
reported: requires results-envelope/1, which is not satisfied

D8_declares_a_profile_it_does_not_satisf.why: an inferred gap is information; a false declaration is a lie

C1_a_document_meeting_both_profiles.why: the healthy shape must pass, or the drill above proves nothing

C2_line_specific_sections_are_not_police.why: profiles constrain the shared envelope, never a line's own content

C3_this_tree_s_real_published_file.why: the file a renderer will actually read must satisfy both

C4_envelope_only_is_a_valid_state_not_a_.why: a line outside results-claims/1 is a rendering branch, not a defect
